description.en: Sets the scale of a named telop caption created with CMND_2DO_CREATE_TELOP.
Name of the telop to scale.
True once it succeeded; false if the named telop isn't ready/found; null if the call itself was invalid (too few arguments).

example.code:
// Scale a telop caption uniformly
CMND_2DO_SCL_SET_TELOP(_name, scale, scale);
